competitorWins: ADS-B Exchange is the honesty champion of flight data: it never filters or obfuscates, so military, government and LADD-blocked aircraft appear when commercial sites hide them. Positions update every 500ms with high-fidelity archives for reconstruction and modelling, trusted by defense firms like Anduril, researchers and journalists. For anyone investigating suspicious flights, dark-state aircraft or historical operations, its raw, unfiltered, researcher-oriented data is unmatched by any consumer globe.
description: ADS-B Exchange is a global, independent flight-data network of 25,000+ community receivers delivering real-time aircraft positions at 500ms latency and traceable flight-path archives, including military and blocked traffic that commercial trackers filter out. It is aimed at researchers, journalists and developers, not casual users. WorldEye is complementary for the general audience: free live flight tracking on a 3D globe plus ships, cameras, weather, quakes and fires — no receiver knowledge required.

verdictCompetitor: Choose ADS-B Exchange if you need unfiltered aircraft data — military and blocked traffic, 500ms positions, archives for investigations — and accept a technical, researcher-oriented platform.
verdictWorldEye: Choose WorldEye if you want a free, signup-free, beautiful globe that mixes live flights with ships, cameras, weather and satellite imagery — perfect for general tracking and curiosity.
whyWorldEye: The map is completely free with no signup — live flights appear on a polished 3D globe instantly.
One globe covers flights AND ships, ~76,000 cameras, weather, earthquakes, wildfires and satellite imagery.
Pro starts at $3.99/week and adds an AI analyst assistant and an OSINT toolkit — a turnkey analyst platform.
